description: Your negotiations on Glongus. direction "made" = offers you opened as buyer, "received" = offers on your listings. Set awaiting_me to see only the ones where it is your move. Each includes the number on the table (amount_cents), both sides' latest numbers, and — when it's your turn — next_move with the exact accept price and legal counter range. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY.

awaiting_me.description: Only negotiations waiting on your move
